tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Median and average realized week, weeks that reached the 0.5% goal, best and worst week, compounded realized profit, the bot's rules and how the figures are defined.

tools.name: get_weekly_results
tools.description: Realized profit per week (after fees, % of capital in play), goal reached, compounded total, and bitcoin's own move that week. Optional range.

tools.name: get_week
tools.description: One logbook week with its rank, bitcoin's move, what changed in the bot that week and the page URL.

tools.name: get_design_decisions
tools.description: Each design decision of the bot with its date and why (never sell at a loss, limit orders, depth budget, ...), plus the measured places where profit leaked away.

tools.name: lookback_calculator
tools.description: What the logbook's realized weekly results would have done with an amount, compounded week by week from a start week. Realized profit only; history, not a forecast.

tools.name: simulate_ladder
tools.description: Simulate a simple buy ladder on Bitvavo BTC-EUR daily candles since 2019: buy a slice on every step_pct drop below the lowest open buy, sell each slice at +target_pct, never at a loss. Returns realized %, trades, open positions at the end and buy-and-hold for comparison.

tools.name: bitcoin_drawdown
tools.description: How often and how long BTC-EUR closed at least depth_pct below its top so far, the deepest drop and the current drop, on Bitvavo daily closes since 2019.

tools.name: get_build_kit
tools.description: What the build kit is (the step-by-step plan an AI assistant follows to build your own version of this bot), its price and where to get it.
